description: NEW-08 regression guard — section-break crossing detection runs on the SHOW thread (Engine::showThreadMain), not the editor-thread SectionScheduler::tick. Plays a clip across a section break at timeline frame 60 (2000000us at 30fps). The show-thread detector must snap + pause the playhead at the break; the editor applies the crossing via SectionScheduler::handleBreakAt from the R2D SectionBreakDetected drain. Then SectionGo resumes playback. Wall-clock-anchored: uses WaitSeconds per scripts/CLAUDE.md (headless --script runs the editor loop at thousands of fps, so WaitFrames would not give the Timeline real wall-clock time to advance to the break).
